name: Barbados
description: Barbados from its first peoples and English sugar to slave rebellion, freedom, independence in 1966 and the republic of 2021.

checkpoints.name: Sugar island
checkpoints.note: English settlers came in 1627 and the island became a sugar colony worked by enslaved Africans. Bussa led the revolt of 1816.

checkpoints.name: Freedom and self-rule
checkpoints.note: Slavery ended in 1834. Workers' riots in 1937 led to the labour movement and self-government.

checkpoints.name: Independent Barbados
checkpoints.note: Barbados became independent in 1966 and a republic in 2021.
